flags.message: All candidates froze distribution_count=1 before the petition's October 7, 2026 docketing; claude-baseline and codex-baseline identify that earlier distribution as concerning linked sealing motion 26M22. The October 14 petition distribution raises outcome.signals.distribution_count to two but does not itself show substantive reconsideration. gemini-baseline's forecast of no further relists is adverse on an additional-distribution reading but consistent on a narrower no-substantive-reconsideration reading. The forecast review records this ambiguity and limits its penalty; no event, outcome, frozen context, or harness-scored quantitative claim was changed.
